description: ADO-EDIT Update and AddNew with Fields/Values arguments sent as scalars, on a server keyset optimistic Recordset of SELECT ID, Code, L, S FROM T ORDER BY ID (read/write copy): Update("S", "u1") on row 1 with no prior edit; MoveNext and Update("S", "u2"); AddNew("Code", "n9"); AddNew with Code set through the Field then Update("S", "u3"); Update("NoSuch", "x"); Update(Missing, "x"); Update("L", "abc"); Update("S", Missing); Update(Empty, Empty); AddNew("Code,S", "n10"). After each read EditMode, the current ID and S, the Errors (cleared); finally the stored rows through Execute. Asks which argument forms are accepted, whether Update with arguments posts or only stages, and the resulting stored rows.
